dialogues.jp: ──ピンポーン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong!*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong!*

dialogues.jp: ──ピンポンピンポン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong ding dong!*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong ding dong!*

dialogues.jp: ──ピポピポピポピポピポーン
dialogues.en: --*dingdongdingdongdingdongdingdongding doooong!*
dialogues.text: --*dingdongdingdongdingdongdingdongding doooong!*

dialogues.jp: 「うるせぇッ！　１回押せばわかるっての！」
dialogues.en: "Stop it! I heard you the first time!"
dialogues.text: "Stop it! I heard you the first time!"

dialogues.jp: ──ピンポーン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong*

dialogues.jp: 「美春ッ！　わかってんだぞ、お前だって！」
dialogues.en: "Miharu! I know it's you, damnit!"
dialogues.text: "Miharu! I know it's you, damnit!"

dialogues.jp:
どうして、あいつはこんなくだらない事ばかり
するんだ。
dialogues.en: Why's she being so damn impatient?
dialogues.text: Why's she being so damn impatient?

dialogues.jp:
月城んちにいくために、一生懸命髪をセットし
てるっていうのに。
dialogues.en:
I was making my hair just perfect, for when I go to
Tsukishiro's home!
dialogues.text:
I was making my hair just perfect, for when I go to
Tsukishiro's home!

dialogues.jp: 「ったく、やめろって言ってンだろッ！」
dialogues.en: "Sheesh, I told you to stop it!"
dialogues.text: "Sheesh, I told you to stop it!"

dialogues.jp: ──バン
dialogues.en: --*bam*
dialogues.text: --*bam*

dialogues.jp: 俺は怒りの表現を込めて、思い切りドアを開く。
dialogues.en: With the anger clear on my face, I threw the door wide open.
dialogues.text: With the anger clear on my face, I threw the door wide open.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、あっ、……月城！？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ah... Tsukishiro!?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, ah... Tsukishiro!?"

dialogues.jp:
そこにいたのは、美春などではなく、月城だっ
た。
dialogues.en: It wasn't Miharu there, but Tsukishiro instead.
dialogues.text: It wasn't Miharu there, but Tsukishiro instead.

dialogues.jp:
私服を着た月城が、もう１度チャイムを鳴らそ
うとしていたポジションのまま固まっていた。
dialogues.en:
Wearing her casual clothes, her finger was halfway towards
pressing the doorbell another time.
dialogues.text:
Wearing her casual clothes, her finger was halfway towards
pressing the doorbell another time.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「いや、ほら、その……月城だとは思わなかっ
　たからさ。その、こんなことするのは美春し
　かいないと思って、その」
dialogues.en:
"N, no, I was, I mean... I didn't think it was you. I
thought it was Miharu doing that, so..."
dialogues.text:
"N, no, I was, I mean... I didn't think it was you. I
thought it was Miharu doing that, so..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、冷や汗をかきながら、一生懸命弁解をす
る。
dialogues.en: I was breaking out in cold sweat, trying my best to explain.
dialogues.text: I was breaking out in cold sweat, trying my best to explain.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……その、月城？」
dialogues.en: "Um.... and, Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "Um.... and, Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「──久しぶり。元気になったか」
dialogues.en: "--It's been awhile. You look better."
dialogues.text: "--It's been awhile. You look better."

dialogues.jp:
月城がきょとんと俺を見上げる。そして、縦に
も横にも首を振ることなく、静かに俯いた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro looked up at me in slight surpirse. Shortly
after, she then bowed her head slightly.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro looked up at me in slight surpirse. Shortly
after, she then bowed her head slightly.

dialogues.jp: そして、月城は、黙り込んでしまった。
dialogues.en: She then remained silent as a mouse.
dialogues.text: She then remained silent as a mouse.

dialogues.jp:
「ようやく、会えたな。月城が落ち込んでるっ
　て聞いて、俺はずっと寂しかったよ」
dialogues.en:
I've finally seen you, heh. When I heard you were feeling
down, I got so worried myself."
dialogues.text:
I've finally seen you, heh. When I heard you were feeling
down, I got so worried myself."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、ただ黙って俯いてるだけだった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro retained her position, practically as still as a
statue.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro retained her position, practically as still as a
statue.

dialogues.jp:
「──で、どうしたんだ？　今日は月城が主役
　だろ」
dialogues.en:
"--Anyway, what's wrong? You should be the main event,
today."
dialogues.text:
"--Anyway, what's wrong? You should be the main event,
today."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……これを」
dialogues.en: "...This."
dialogues.text: "...This."

dialogues.jp:
月城はそう言って、なにやら綺麗な白い封筒を
差し出した。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro handed to me, a pretty white envelope.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro handed to me, a pretty white envelope.

dialogues.en: "A written invitation...?"
dialogues.text: "A written invitation...?"

dialogues.jp: 月城がこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.jp:
全部で３人分。どうやら、俺と美春と杉並の分
のようだ。
dialogues.en:
There's three of them inside. I suppose it's for Miharu,
Suginami and myself.
dialogues.text:
There's three of them inside. I suppose it's for Miharu,
Suginami and myself.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, farewell."

dialogues.jp:
月城はそう言って、屋敷の方へ向かって、すた
すたと走っていった。
dialogues.en:
As soon as she finished speaking, she ranoff towards the
direction of the mansion.
dialogues.text:
As soon as she finished speaking, she ranoff towards the
direction of the mansion.

dialogues.jp:
人形でもあれば、もう少し話をしてくれたのか
もしれないけど、あの人形はもうない。
dialogues.en:
Maybe she'd have talked a little more if she still had the
doll... but it is no longer.
dialogues.text:
Maybe she'd have talked a little more if she still had the
doll... but it is no longer.

dialogues.jp: さて、もう１度髪のセットをし直すか。
dialogues.en: Now then, time to fix my hair again.
dialogues.text: Now then, time to fix my hair again.

dialogues.jp:
でも月城、今日はあの調子で大丈夫なのかな
……。
dialogues.en:
I wonder whether Tsukishiro's really in the right mood
today...
dialogues.text:
I wonder whether Tsukishiro's really in the right mood
today...

dialogues.jp: ──ピンポーン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong!*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong!*

dialogues.jp: ──ピンポンピンポン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong ding dong!*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong ding dong!*

dialogues.jp: ──ピンポンピンポンピンポーン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong ding dong ding doooong!*"
dialogues.text: --*ding dong ding dong ding doooong!*"

dialogues.jp: 「また、月城かな……」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro again..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro again..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、きびすを返し、にこやかな顔で玄関のド
アを開ける。
dialogues.en:
Masking my annoyance, I put on a bright smile as I went to
answer the door.
dialogues.text:
Masking my annoyance, I put on a bright smile as I went to
answer the door.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、こんにちわ！　月城さんの家に、行き
　ましょう！」
dialogues.en:
"Senpai, good afternoon! Let's head for Tsukishiro-san's
home!"
dialogues.text:
"Senpai, good afternoon! Let's head for Tsukishiro-san's
home!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……み、美春か」
dialogues.en: "...M, Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "...M, Miharu..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は拳を握り、ふるふると震わせる。
dialogues.en:
My hands instictively rolled up into fists, and started
trembling.
dialogues.text:
My hands instictively rolled up into fists, and started
trembling.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？」
dialogues.en: "Haeeh?"
dialogues.text: "Haeeh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ったく、うるさいっての！」
dialogues.en: "Grr, you're always so loud!!"
dialogues.text: "Grr, you're always so loud!!"

dialogues.jp: ──ぐりぐりぐり、ぐりこっ！！
dialogues.en: --*grind, grind, grind, grind!*
dialogues.text: --*grind, grind, grind, grind!*

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あいたたたたたたッ、痛いですようぅ！！」
dialogues.en: "Owowowowowowow, it hurrrrts!"
dialogues.text: "Owowowowowowow, it hurrrrts!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「二度とバナナを食べることができなくなるツ
　ボを押すぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Do you ever want to taste a banana again?"
dialogues.text: "Do you ever want to taste a banana again?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それだけは、ご容赦くださいませぇッ！」
dialogues.en: "P, please forgive me, your majesty!!"
dialogues.text: "P, please forgive me, your majesty!!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、美春の両のこめかみに拳をあて、ぐりぐ
りを炸裂させた。
dialogues.en:
I had placed my two fists at the sides of her forehead, and
was grinding them inwards.
dialogues.text:
I had placed my two fists at the sides of her forehead, and
was grinding them inwards.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いいから、早く行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Alright already, hurry up and let's go."
dialogues.text: "Alright already, hurry up and let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「え、ちょっと待って……、俺、まだ髪の毛の
　セットが……。まだＴシャツだし」
dialogues.en:
"Eh, wait a sec... I'm not done with my hair... and I'm
still wearing a t-shirt..."
dialogues.text:
"Eh, wait a sec... I'm not done with my hair... and I'm
still wearing a t-shirt..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「大して変わりはしない。それより、早く行く
　ぞ」
dialogues.en: "It won't make a big difference. Come on, let's just go."
dialogues.text: "It won't make a big difference. Come on, let's just go."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、俺の腕をつかみ、月城邸の方へ足を向
ける。
dialogues.en:
Suginami grabbed my arm, and dragged me in the direction of
Tsukishiro Mansion.
dialogues.text:
Suginami grabbed my arm, and dragged me in the direction of
Tsukishiro Mansion.

dialogues.jp:
なんとか、身だしなみだけは整えさせてもらい、
ふたりには、月城から預かった招待状を渡した。
dialogues.en:
As we arranged things on the way there, I gave the other two
their invitations which I received from Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
As we arranged things on the way there, I gave the other two
their invitations which I received from Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
招待状には、日付が書いてあったが、２５日と
なっていた。
dialogues.en: The date written on the invitations was the 25th.
dialogues.text: The date written on the invitations was the 25th.

dialogues.jp:
本来は、もっと早くにもらえるものだったのか
も知れない。
dialogues.en: It seems it should've reached us much earlier...
dialogues.text: It seems it should've reached us much earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「ようこそいらっしゃいました。招待状を拝見
　いたします」
dialogues.en: "Welcome to our humble home. May I see your invitations?"
dialogues.text: "Welcome to our humble home. May I see your invitations?"

dialogues.jp:
リビングでは、瀬場さんがにっこりと笑いなが
ら、手を差し出す。
dialogues.en:
At the living room, Seiba-san held out his hand, with his
usual wide smile.
dialogues.text:
At the living room, Seiba-san held out his hand, with his
usual wide smile.

dialogues.jp:
「これでいいんですよね？　さっきもらったば
　かりだから……」
dialogues.en: 'Is this okay? We only just received it earlier..."
dialogues.text: 'Is this okay? We only just received it earlier..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「さっき？　お嬢様は確か一昨日にお作りにな
　られたはず」
dialogues.en:
"Earlier? I believe the mistress created the invitations two
days ago."
dialogues.text:
"Earlier? I believe the mistress created the invitations two
days ago."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「さっき、月城が来て、俺に３通ほど」
dialogues.en:
"Earlier today, Tsukishiro came to my house, and gave me all
three of them."
dialogues.text:
"Earlier today, Tsukishiro came to my house, and gave me all
three of them."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか。おそらく、お嬢様は朝倉様達を
　ご招待するかどうか、迷われたようですな」
dialogues.en:
"I see. Perhaps the mistress thought that it would be a
bother for everyone to receive such a thing."
dialogues.text:
"I see. Perhaps the mistress thought that it would be a
bother for everyone to receive such a thing."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「でも、招待状をくれたってことは、風向きは
　良好ってことかな」
dialogues.en: "But the invitation is really well done..."
dialogues.text: "But the invitation is really well done..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「かもしれません。ささ、いろいろと用意して
　ございますので、どうぞ、お入りくださいま
　せ」
dialogues.en:
"That may be so. Come now, we have much ground to cover
today."
dialogues.text:
"That may be so. Come now, we have much ground to cover
today."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんの案内で、リビングに入る。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san quickly ushered us into the living room.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san quickly ushered us into the living room.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルには、つまみやすい料理やお菓子がた
くさん並べられていた。
dialogues.en: The table carried a literal feast of food.
dialogues.text: The table carried a literal feast of food.

dialogues.jp:
そして、テーブルの上座には、月城がちょこん
と座っていた。
dialogues.en: And Tsukishiro was sitting there, at the seat of honour.
dialogues.text: And Tsukishiro was sitting there, at the seat of honour.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「ささ、お嬢様。皆様いらっしゃいましたよ。
　ご挨拶を」
dialogues.en: "Now, mistress. Please welcome everyone."
dialogues.text: "Now, mistress. Please welcome everyone."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……みなさん、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you for coming."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you for coming."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、か細い声で、そう言って、ぺこりとお
辞儀をした。
dialogues.en:
With her tender voice, she said her thanks, and bowed
politely.
dialogues.text:
With her tender voice, she said her thanks, and bowed
politely.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「月城さん、お誕生日おめでとう！」
dialogues.en: "Happy birthday, Tsukishiro-san!"
dialogues.text: "Happy birthday, Tsukishiro-san!"

dialogues.jp:
最初にそう言ったのは、美春だった。俺や杉並
を押しのけて前に出た。
dialogues.en:
Miharu jumped in front of Suginami and I, and said her piece
first.
dialogues.text:
Miharu jumped in front of Suginami and I, and said her piece
first.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「これ、プレゼント。美春が作ったバナナクッ
　キーです」
dialogues.en:
"This is your present. It's a banana cake, I made it
myself!"
dialogues.text:
"This is your present. It's a banana cake, I made it
myself!"

dialogues.jp:
美春がバッグの中からそれを取り出すと、部屋
の中にぷぅんと甘いバナナの香りがした。
dialogues.en:
Miharu took the cake out of a large bag, and the room was
instantly filled with the sweet scent of banana.
dialogues.text:
Miharu took the cake out of a large bag, and the room was
instantly filled with the sweet scent of banana.

dialogues.jp: 手作りだと、こんな匂いがするのか……。
dialogues.en: Homemade cakes can have this amazing smell...
dialogues.text: Homemade cakes can have this amazing smell...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それで、これだけじゃつまらないじゃないで
　すか。だから、こんなものを作ってきました」
dialogues.en:
"I thought that might not be enough too, so I made this as
well!"
dialogues.text:
"I thought that might not be enough too, so I made this as
well!"

dialogues.jp:
美春は再びバッグの中に手を入れ、なにやら黄
色い物体を取り出した。
dialogues.en:
She reached into the bag once again, and pulled out a big
yellow... thing.
dialogues.text:
She reached into the bag once again, and pulled out a big
yellow... thing.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「バナナのクッションです。おうちにあった布
　で作ってみました」
dialogues.en:
"It's a banana cushion! It's supposed to be held while you
sleep!"
dialogues.text:
"It's a banana cushion! It's supposed to be held while you
sleep!"

dialogues.jp:
そのクッションは、店で売っているようなきち
んとしたもので、買ってきたと言われても信じ
てしまいそうなくらいよくできていた。
dialogues.en:
There's no way I could believe that any self-respecting
store would sell something like that.
dialogues.text:
There's no way I could believe that any self-respecting
store would sell something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「すごいのは、ちゃんと皮が｛む／剥｝けるところです。
　だからどうってワケじゃないんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"The best part is, you can peel off the skin just like a
real banana! It doesn't do anything, though."
dialogues.text:
"The best part is, you can peel off the skin just like a
real banana! It doesn't do anything, though."

dialogues.jp:
美春が、クッションの頭をつまんで引っ張ると、
バナナの皮が剥けるように、黄色い部分が剥け
ていく。
dialogues.en:
Miharu demonstrated it herself, peeling off sections of the
cushion, just like you would to a real banana.
dialogues.text:
Miharu demonstrated it herself, peeling off sections of the
cushion, just like you would to a real banana.

dialogues.jp: どうやら、ファスナーで留めてあるようだ。
dialogues.en: Seems like that part was done using fasteners.
dialogues.text: Seems like that part was done using fasteners.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春はあまりお金持ちではないので、全部手
　作りになってしまいましたけど。心を込めて
　作りました」
dialogues.en:
"I don't have much much to spend, so I made all these
myself. I put all my heart into it!"
dialogues.text:
"I don't have much much to spend, so I made all these
myself. I put all my heart into it!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……、……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "......Thank you."
dialogues.text: "......Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、言葉を詰らせながら、美春からクッショ
ンとクッキーを受け取った。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, seemingly grateful, received the cushion and
cake from Miharu.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, seemingly grateful, received the cushion and
cake from Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「次は、俺だな」
dialogues.en: "Next up, would be me."
dialogues.text: "Next up, would be me."

dialogues.jp:
杉並が不敵な笑みを浮かべて、ずいっとしゃしゃ
り出てくる。
dialogues.en: One of those bold smiles passed through his lips.
dialogues.text: One of those bold smiles passed through his lips.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、大したものではないのだがな。ピロス
　キーに代わる新しい人形だ！」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I didn't get anything too major. Just a doll to
replace Pirosuki!"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I didn't get anything too major. Just a doll to
replace Pirosuki!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、またそんなことを……！」
dialogues.en: "You, still going on about that...!"
dialogues.text: "You, still going on about that...!"

dialogues.jp: しかし、月城が１歩前へ出て、俺を制する。
dialogues.en:
But, Tsukishiro moved one step in front of me, indirectly
telling me to stop.
dialogues.text:
But, Tsukishiro moved one step in front of me, indirectly
telling me to stop.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふふ、月城嬢も俺の出す人形を欲しているよ
　うだな……」
dialogues.en:
"Hoho, even Tsukishiro-jou wants to see the doll I'm about
to produce..."
dialogues.text:
"Hoho, even Tsukishiro-jou wants to see the doll I'm about
to produce..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はがさごそと紙袋に手を突っ込み、なにや
ら木製の人形を取り出す。
dialogues.en:
Suginami plunged his hand into his paper bag, and then
thrust it out, revealing a weird-looking wooden doll.
dialogues.text:
Suginami plunged his hand into his paper bag, and then
thrust it out, revealing a weird-looking wooden doll.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ベトナムの伝統芸能、水上人形劇用の農家の
　奥さんの人形だッ！」
dialogues.en:
"From the theatres of Vietnam, the amphibious farmer's wife
doll!"
dialogues.text:
"From the theatres of Vietnam, the amphibious farmer's wife
doll!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「また伝統芸能かよ」
dialogues.en: "T, theatrical hijinks, again...?"
dialogues.text: "T, theatrical hijinks, again...?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「またとはなんだ、またとは。水上を舞台に人
　形劇を行うという、他に類を見ない舞台劇だ
　ぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"This is not an "again", my friend! When have you ever seen
a puppet play, taking place underwater!?"
dialogues.text:
"This is not an "again", my friend! When have you ever seen
a puppet play, taking place underwater!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……どうしろってんだよ、そんなの」
dialogues.en: "...And what can be done with that thing?"
dialogues.text: "...And what can be done with that thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな、月城嬢が舞台の後ろから、この人
　形を操って話をするという……」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-jou could use it when she puts on a play,
manipulating it's strings from behind..."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-jou could use it when she puts on a play,
manipulating it's strings from behind..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どこに舞台があるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "And where do you see a stage?"
dialogues.text: "And where do you see a stage?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「持ち歩くとかな」
dialogues.en: "One can be made for it."
dialogues.text: "One can be made for it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「──月城、いらなきゃ断ってもいいんだぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"--Tsukishiro, you can reject whatever you don't like,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"--Tsukishiro, you can reject whatever you don't like,
okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さあ、月城嬢もこの水辺で育ったイチジクの
　木で作られた、温かみのある人形に触れるが
　いい！」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-jou wil love this fig-tree doll, made by the
riverside, and warm to the touch!"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-jou wil love this fig-tree doll, made by the
riverside, and warm to the touch!"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、俺と杉並の顔を交互に見て、結局その
人形に手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro looked back and forth between Suginami and
myself, and eventually stretched her hands out to the doll.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro looked back and forth between Suginami and
myself, and eventually stretched her hands out to the doll.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……杉並、先輩、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Suginami, senpai, thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Suginami, senpai, thank you."

dialogues.jp:
たどたどしい言葉でそう言って、ぺこりと頭を
下げる。
dialogues.en:
With a little difficulty, she got her words of thanks out,
and bowed.
dialogues.text:
With a little difficulty, she got her words of thanks out,
and bowed.

dialogues.jp:
で、ようやく俺の番になった訳だが、正直他の
ふたりに比べるとどうかとは思う。
dialogues.en:
Now it was finally my turn, although I didn't think my gift
compared to the other two.
dialogues.text:
Now it was finally my turn, although I didn't think my gift
compared to the other two.

dialogues.jp:
美春のように手作りって訳でもないし、杉並の
ようにインパクトが有る訳ではない（アレはア
レでなんとなく許せないものがあるが）。
dialogues.en:
It didn't have the handmade love of Miharu's, or the impact
of Suginami's (although I still wouldn't forgive him).
dialogues.text:
It didn't have the handmade love of Miharu's, or the impact
of Suginami's (although I still wouldn't forgive him).

dialogues.jp:
「これ……。あの花の代わりって訳じゃないけ
　ど、いいかなって思って」
dialogues.en:
"This... isn't meant to replace that flower, but I thought
it'd be a good gift."
dialogues.text:
"This... isn't meant to replace that flower, but I thought
it'd be a good gift."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、花屋で買ってきたラベンダーの鉢植えを
差し出した。
dialogues.en:
I showed her what I had bought; a lavender potted plant,
from the flower shop.
dialogues.text:
I showed her what I had bought; a lavender potted plant,
from the flower shop.

dialogues.jp:
開花時期は７月頃ということで、まだ花は咲い
ていなかったけれど、綺麗な緑色の葉がピンと
生えていた。
dialogues.en:
It's blooming period is in August, so there were no flowers
blooming yet, but a beautiful green leaf was sprouting from
it.
dialogues.text:
It's blooming period is in August, so there were no flowers
blooming yet, but a beautiful green leaf was sprouting from
it.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「…………、……ごめんなさい」

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……受け取れない」
dialogues.en: "...I can't accept this."
dialogues.text: "...I can't accept this."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry, senpai."

dialogues.jp:
月城が、ふるふると首を横に振りながら、大げ
さなくらいに頭を下げた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro shook her head left and right, then bowed deeply
to me.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro shook her head left and right, then bowed deeply
to me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I'm very sorry.
dialogues.text: "...I'm very sorry.

dialogues.jp:
そうか……。花の鉢植えじゃ、月城にロスキル
ラベンダーのことを思い出させてしまうだけだっ
たのか……。
dialogues.en:
That's right... a flower, even a potted plant like this,
will always remind Tsukishiro fo the Roskill Lavender...
dialogues.text:
That's right... a flower, even a potted plant like this,
will always remind Tsukishiro fo the Roskill Lavender...

dialogues.jp:
自分の身体を張ってまで守ろうとした花の代替
品なんて、ほしい訳がない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't want to replace the flower she held so dearly in
her heart, even if I didn't mean to.
dialogues.text:
I didn't want to replace the flower she held so dearly in
her heart, even if I didn't mean to.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺が悪かったんだ。月城、すまない」
dialogues.en: "No, it's my fault, Tsukishiro. Sorry..."
dialogues.text: "No, it's my fault, Tsukishiro. Sorry..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、鉢植えを下げ、目の届きにくい場所に置
いた。
dialogues.en: I took back the potted plant, and put it back into my bag.
dialogues.text: I took back the potted plant, and put it back into my bag.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さあ、朝倉のダメなプレゼントのことなど忘
　れて、ぱぁっと行こうじゃないか！」
dialogues.en:
"Now now, let's forget about Asakura's stupid present, and
get this party started!"
dialogues.text:
"Now now, let's forget about Asakura's stupid present, and
get this party started!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そうですよね、ぱぁっと！　って、あわ
　わ、先輩のプレゼントがダメだったって言っ
　てる訳じゃないですよ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, let's! ...Awahwah, I didn't mean that senpai's
present was useless!!"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, let's! ...Awahwah, I didn't mean that senpai's
present was useless!!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、いいんだ。月城、あらためて、誕生日
　おめでとう」
dialogues.en: "No, it's alright. Tsukishiro, once again, happy Birthday."
dialogues.text: "No, it's alright. Tsukishiro, once again, happy Birthday."

dialogues.jp:
しばらく間を置いてから、月城はぼそりとそう
言った。
dialogues.en: After a short pause, she replied gratefully.
dialogues.text: After a short pause, she replied gratefully.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「誕生日といえば、歌だ。歌を歌おう」
dialogues.en:
"Whenever there's a birthday, there's a song. Let's sing
something!"
dialogues.text:
"Whenever there's a birthday, there's a song. Let's sing
something!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「う、歌だとぉ？　こ、この歳になってか」
dialogues.en: "S, sing? At this age?"
dialogues.text: "S, sing? At this age?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え、美春は歌は大好きですよ？　この前の美
　春の誕生日の時に、みんなが集まった時にも
　歌を歌いましたもん」
dialogues.en:
"Ehh? But I love singing! Don't you remember, everyone
gathering during my birthday this year, and singing out
loud?"
dialogues.text:
"Ehh? But I love singing! Don't you remember, everyone
gathering during my birthday this year, and singing out
loud?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……あれ、美春、誕生日……だったっけ」
dialogues.en: "Ah... erm, Miharu's, birthday..... yeah."
dialogues.text: "Ah... erm, Miharu's, birthday..... yeah."

dialogues.jp: 不覚。言われるまで、すっかり忘れていた。
dialogues.en: Failure. I'd completely forgotten about hers.
dialogues.text: Failure. I'd completely forgotten about hers.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうですよ〜？　今度プレゼントくださいね？
　待ってますから」
dialogues.en:
"Riiiight~? You'd have a present for next time, right? I'd
be waiting!"
dialogues.text:
"Riiiight~? You'd have a present for next time, right? I'd
be waiting!"

dialogues.jp:
美春がじろりと俺を｛にら／睨｝みながら、脅迫めいた口
調でそう言った。
dialogues.en: Miharu glared at me, in accompaniment with her threat.
dialogues.text: Miharu glared at me, in accompaniment with her threat.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「私も歌は好きですな。歌は人々を明るく楽し
　くさせる効果があります」
dialogues.en:
"I myself like singing as well. The act of singing has the
effect of cheering up and brightening people's moods."
dialogues.text:
"I myself like singing as well. The act of singing has the
effect of cheering up and brightening people's moods."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「その通り！　歌は組織内の一体感を高めたり、
　高揚感を高める効果もあるのだッ！　わんこ
　嬢、さあ、歌いたまえ」
dialogues.en:
"Indeed! Songs not only enrich the people singing, but the
people listening as well! My dear puppy, sing for us!"
dialogues.text:
"Indeed! Songs not only enrich the people singing, but the
people listening as well! My dear puppy, sing for us!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「えっ、えっ、美春ですかぁ？　まあ、じゃあ
　せっかくですから、オリジナルバースデーソ
　ングを……」
dialogues.en: "Ehh, ehhh, mee? Well, then, an original birthday song..."
dialogues.text: "Ehh, ehhh, mee? Well, then, an original birthday song..."

dialogues.jp: コホンと咳払いをする美春。
dialogues.en: Miharu cleared her throat, getting ready to sing.
dialogues.text: Miharu cleared her throat, getting ready to sing.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それではぁ、不肖天枷美春、月城アリスさん
　のお誕生日を祝う歌を歌いますぅ！」
dialogues.en:
"And now, Amakase Miharu will sing a song to celeberate
Tsukishiro-san's birthday!"
dialogues.text:
"And now, Amakase Miharu will sing a song to celeberate
Tsukishiro-san's birthday!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今日は、素敵な誕生日〜♪　とっても素敵な
　誕生日〜♪　月城さんの生まれた日〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"Today is a wonderful birthday~♪ A very wonderful
birthday~♪ It's Tsukshiro-san's birthday~♪"
dialogues.text:
"Today is a wonderful birthday~♪ A very wonderful
birthday~♪ It's Tsukshiro-san's birthday~♪"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今年もこれから仲良くね〜♪　来年もずっと
　仲良くね〜♪　今日は、素敵な誕生日〜♪
　おめでとう〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"Let's get along well from this day~♪ And next year and
always~♪ Today is a wonderful birthday~♪ Happy
Birthday~!♪"
dialogues.text:
"Let's get along well from this day~♪ And next year and
always~♪ Today is a wonderful birthday~♪ Happy
Birthday~!♪"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おお〜」
dialogues.en: "Ohhhhh~!"
dialogues.text: "Ohhhhh~!"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「素晴らしい……」
dialogues.en: "Magnificent..."
dialogues.text: "Magnificent..."

dialogues.jp:
なんだかよくわかんないけれど、誕生日っぽい
歌だな。美春が作った割には、いい歌だ。
dialogues.en:
I've never heard of it before, but it's an apt song for a
birthday. It's pretty good, considering it was made by
Miharu.
dialogues.text:
I've never heard of it before, but it's an apt song for a
birthday. It's pretty good, considering it was made by
Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうですか？　月城さん」
dialogues.en: "How was it, Tsukishiro-san?"
dialogues.text: "How was it, Tsukishiro-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……、……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: ".........Thank you."
dialogues.text: ".........Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 月城がぺこりと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro bowed her head politely.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro bowed her head politely.

dialogues.jp:
主賓が相変わらず、何も喋らないので、どうし
ても盛り上がりに欠ける感じだ。
dialogues.en:
The guest of honour, as always, refused to speak a casual
word, despite the rousing mood.
dialogues.text:
The guest of honour, as always, refused to speak a casual
word, despite the rousing mood.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「ささ、皆様。お飲物をお注ぎ致しますので、
　どうぞ、お召し上がりください」
dialogues.en:
"Now then, everyone, please feel free to taste any of the
culinary delights on offer."
dialogues.text:
"Now then, everyone, please feel free to taste any of the
culinary delights on offer."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが、にこやかな声で場を盛り上げる。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san joyfully announced to us his invitation.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san joyfully announced to us his invitation.

dialogues.jp:
その後、杉並も美春も、黙らせたいほど喋り続
けたが、肝心の月城はそれほど話をする訳でも
なく、なんだか空回りな気がした。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and Miharu tried to strike up conversation, but
Tsukishiro still wouldn't say more than what was neccessary.
dialogues.text:
Suginami and Miharu tried to strike up conversation, but
Tsukishiro still wouldn't say more than what was neccessary.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それでもパーティー自体は盛り上がった訳
で、形だけは楽しいものとなった。
dialogues.en: Even then, as the party went on, she seemed to get happier.
dialogues.text: Even then, as the party went on, she seemed to get happier.

dialogues.jp:
そして、しばらくして、腹もふくれ、落ち着き
を見せた頃、
dialogues.en:
Finally, after awhile, she rubbed her stomach, and calmly
looked at the clock,
dialogues.text:
Finally, after awhile, she rubbed her stomach, and calmly
looked at the clock,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……上で、休みます」
dialogues.en: "...I'm resting upstairs."
dialogues.text: "...I'm resting upstairs."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、たどたどしく、そう言った。
dialogues.en: She said, barely getting the words out.
dialogues.text: She said, barely getting the words out.

dialogues.jp:
そして、ぺこりと頭を下げ、２階の自分の部屋
へあがっていった。
dialogues.en:
And with a bow, headed up the stairs to her room on the
second floor."
dialogues.text:
And with a bow, headed up the stairs to her room on the
second floor."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「それでは、今日はこの辺でお開きということ
　で……」
dialogues.en: "I suppose that spells the end of the party..."
dialogues.text: "I suppose that spells the end of the party..."

dialogues.jp:
パーティーは、それで終了し、俺達は引き上げ
ることになるのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Now that it's over, I guess there's no reason to hang
around...
dialogues.text:
Now that it's over, I guess there's no reason to hang
around...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした、朝倉。帰らんのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong, Asakura? Not going back?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, Asakura? Not going back?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……いや、お前らだけ先に帰れよ。俺は、
　ちょっと月城の様子を見てくる」
dialogues.en: "...Nah, you guys go first. I want to check on Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "...Nah, you guys go first. I want to check on Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そう言ってリビングの扉を開け、階段を
のぼる。
dialogues.en:
I went out the living room, and started walking up the
stairway.
dialogues.text:
I went out the living room, and started walking up the
stairway.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え、先輩……ちょっと」
dialogues.en: "Eh, senpai... wait..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, senpai... wait..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城の部屋の前に立ち、軽くノックする。
dialogues.en:
Standing in front of Tsukishiro's room, I knocked lightly on
her door.
dialogues.text:
Standing in front of Tsukishiro's room, I knocked lightly on
her door.

dialogues.jp: 「月城。俺だ。朝倉だ。入っていいか？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro? It's me, Asakura. Can I come in?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro? It's me, Asakura. Can I come in?"

dialogues.jp: しかし、返事はない。
dialogues.en: But, there was no answer.
dialogues.text: But, there was no answer.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、入るぞ、いいか」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, I'm coming in, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, I'm coming in, okay?"

dialogues.jp:
やはり、返事はなかった。けれど、俺は、ドア
のノブを回すことにした。
dialogues.en:
Still no reply. Despite that, I turned the knob and opened
the door.
dialogues.text:
Still no reply. Despite that, I turned the knob and opened
the door.

dialogues.jp: 「月城。勝手に入って悪ィ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry for just entering like that, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Sorry for just entering like that, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、窓際にある机の椅子に座り、ぼうっと
外を眺めていた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was sitting at a desk near the window, staring
outside.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was sitting at a desk near the window, staring
outside.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、｛じゅうたん／絨毯｝の上にぺたんと座った。
dialogues.en: I took a seat on the carpet laid out on the floor.
dialogues.text: I took a seat on the carpet laid out on the floor.

dialogues.jp:
「今日は、悪かったな。変なプレゼント買って
　きちゃって」
dialogues.en: "Sorry about today... I guess that was a weird present."
dialogues.text: "Sorry about today... I guess that was a weird present."

dialogues.jp: ふるふると首を振る月城。
dialogues.en: She shook her head.
dialogues.text: She shook her head.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩は、どうして私を」
dialogues.en: "...Why did senpai... with me..."
dialogues.text: "...Why did senpai... with me..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「どうして月城に会いに来るのかってことか？」
dialogues.en: "Why did I go to see you all those times?"
dialogues.text: "Why did I go to see you all those times?"

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだろうな。はっきり言って、理由らしい
　理由は俺にもよくわからないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I wonder myself. To be exact, I have a reason, but I can't
really explain it clearly."
dialogues.text:
"I wonder myself. To be exact, I have a reason, but I can't
really explain it clearly."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、俺は月城のことが気になってさ。放っ
　ておけないっていうか」
dialogues.en:
"I was just kinda thinking about you constantly, and didn't
want to leave you..."
dialogues.text:
"I was just kinda thinking about you constantly, and didn't
want to leave you..."

dialogues.jp:
その｛とび／鳶｝色の瞳は、一体何を見ているのか。何を
見ようとしているのか、それが知りたかった。
dialogues.en:
What are those purple eyes looking at? Things like that, I
want to know...
dialogues.text:
What are those purple eyes looking at? Things like that, I
want to know...

dialogues.jp:
「月城は……、どうして俺と話をしてくれるん
　だ？」
dialogues.en: "Now, it's my turn... why did you talk to me?"
dialogues.text: "Now, it's my turn... why did you talk to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「月城は、人と話すのが苦手なのに、俺のこと
　は受け入れてくれるじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"I know you're bad at talking with poeple... yet for some
reason, you decided to accept me..."
dialogues.text:
"I know you're bad at talking with poeple... yet for some
reason, you decided to accept me..."

dialogues.jp:
人形を使って、の会話がほとんどだった気がす
るけれど、それでもあれを月城の気持ちとすれ
ば、それなりに好意的だったと思う。
dialogues.en:
It may have been a doll talking to me most of the time, but
her own feelings to me always seemed favourable.
dialogues.text:
It may have been a doll talking to me most of the time, but
her own feelings to me always seemed favourable.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……最初は、イヤでした」
dialogues.en: "...At first, I didn't..."
dialogues.text: "...At first, I didn't..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、お話してて」
dialogues.en: "...But, after talking..."
dialogues.text: "...But, after talking..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……今は、イヤじゃないです」
dialogues.en: "...I don't mind now."
dialogues.text: "...I don't mind now."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、相変わらずぼうっと窓の外を眺めなが
らそう答えた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro continued to stare out her window, as she
answered.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro continued to stare out her window, as she
answered.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩に会うと、嬉しいです」
dialogues.en: "...I'm glad I met you."
dialogues.text: "...I'm glad I met you."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、ピロスはもういないから」
dialogues.en: "...But, Piros is gone..."
dialogues.text: "...But, Piros is gone..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「人形が無くても……」
dialogues.en: "The doll is gone..."
dialogues.text: "The doll is gone..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ロスキルラベンダー」
dialogues.en: "...And the Roskill Lavender..."
dialogues.text: "...And the Roskill Lavender..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……もう、種はないの」
dialogues.en: "...I have no more seeds."
dialogues.text: "...I have no more seeds."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……もう、ダメなの」
dialogues.en: "...It's hopeless now..."
dialogues.text: "...It's hopeless now..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……私は、ずっと独りぼっち」
dialogues.en: "...I'd... always be alone."
dialogues.text: "...I'd... always be alone."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「独りぼっちって、月城……！」
dialogues.en: "Alone...?! Tsukshiro...!"
dialogues.text: "Alone...?! Tsukshiro...!"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ゆらりと立ち上がり、とぼとぼとベッ
ドのそばへ行き、そのままどさりと倒れてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro unsteadily got up, and stumbled her way to the
bed, collapsing onto it.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro unsteadily got up, and stumbled her way to the
bed, collapsing onto it.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ベッドに突っ伏したまま、小さく肩を
震わせた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's body seemed lifeless as it lay on the bed,
shivering occasionally.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's body seemed lifeless as it lay on the bed,
shivering occasionally.

dialogues.jp:
「月城、俺は……、いや、美春や杉並だって、
　月城のことが」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, I'll always... no, not just me, but Miharu and
Suginami as well..."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, I'll always... no, not just me, but Miharu and
Suginami as well..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……今日は、帰って」
dialogues.en: "...Please go home..."
dialogues.text: "...Please go home..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、何も言えなくなった。
dialogues.en: I had no words left to say.
dialogues.text: I had no words left to say.

dialogues.jp:
これ以上、ここにいても、きっと月城を傷つけ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: If I stay any further, I was only going to hurt her.
dialogues.text: If I stay any further, I was only going to hurt her.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、部屋を出た。
dialogues.en: I left her room.
dialogues.text: I left her room.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「瀬場さん、ロスキルラベンダーについて、何
　か知っていますか？」
dialogues.en:
"Seiba-san, do you know anything about a flower, Roskill
Lavender?"
dialogues.text:
"Seiba-san, do you know anything about a flower, Roskill
Lavender?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「ロスキルラベンダー……。お嬢様が育ててい
　らっしゃった花ですね？」
dialogues.en:
"Roskill Lavender... was that the plant the mistress was
attempting to cultivate?"
dialogues.text:
"Roskill Lavender... was that the plant the mistress was
attempting to cultivate?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「そうです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it is."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it is."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「あれは、確か……北欧の、お嬢様がお生まれ
　になった土地の花だと聞いております」
dialogues.en:
"From what I've heard... it is a plant grown mostly in
Scandinavian countries, such as the one the mistress was
born in."
dialogues.text:
"From what I've heard... it is a plant grown mostly in
Scandinavian countries, such as the one the mistress was
born in."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「寒い高山に生える植物で、１年に１度ほど、
　ほんの数時間、美しい花を咲かせるのだそう
　です」
dialogues.en:
"It grows only on the top of cold mountains, once a year.
After much time has passed, it blooms into a beautiful
flower."
dialogues.text:
"It grows only on the top of cold mountains, once a year.
After much time has passed, it blooms into a beautiful
flower."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「そんな花なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What flower would that be?"
dialogues.text: "What flower would that be?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「私も詳しくはよく存じ上げません。ただ、そ
　の短い時間に咲いた花に祈ると、願いが叶う
　という言い伝えがあるのだそうです」
dialogues.en:
"I do not know much about it myself. I have heard that if
you wish on the flower in the time it blooms, your wish will
be granted."
dialogues.text:
"I do not know much about it myself. I have heard that if
you wish on the flower in the time it blooms, your wish will
be granted."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「願いが叶う……」
dialogues.en: "Wish, granted..."
dialogues.text: "Wish, granted..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい、お嬢様も、何か願いがあって育ててら
　したようですが、どんな願いをされていたの
　かは存じ上げません」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. The mistress appears to have a wish, to have raised
that plant so desperately; but I do not know what it is."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. The mistress appears to have a wish, to have raised
that plant so desperately; but I do not know what it is."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですか？　俺も全然教えてもらえな
　かったんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Really? She's never told me anything about it, either."
dialogues.text: "Really? She's never told me anything about it, either."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「人に願いを知られてしまうと、その願いは叶
　わなくなるそうです」
dialogues.en:
"If others know your wish, then I don't believe it would
come true."
dialogues.text:
"If others know your wish, then I don't believe it would
come true."

dialogues.jp: それで、絶対に教えてくれなかったのか。
dialogues.en: If that's the case, I'd definitely never know.
dialogues.text: If that's the case, I'd definitely never know.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様は、こちらに帰られてから、毎年花を
　育てていらしたようですが、ただの１度も花
　が咲くことはありませんでした」
dialogues.en:
"Since the mistress came to this island, she has tried every
year to make the plant grow, but it has not bloomed even
once."
dialogues.text:
"Since the mistress came to this island, she has tried every
year to make the plant grow, but it has not bloomed even
once."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「それどころか、うまく育たないことの方が多
　かったようです」
dialogues.en: "The failures were many, but the successes were none."
dialogues.text: "The failures were many, but the successes were none."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「今年も、先日の嵐で、ダメになってしまった
　みたいですね」
dialogues.en:
"This year as well, the recent storm more or less killed
it..."
dialogues.text:
"This year as well, the recent storm more or less killed
it..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「確か、お嬢様が持っていらしたロスキルラベ
　ンダーの種は、今年のもので終わりだったは
　ずです」
dialogues.en:
"It appears the seed that the mistress used to plant this
year's attempt, was the final one she possessed."
dialogues.text:
"It appears the seed that the mistress used to plant this
year's attempt, was the final one she possessed."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「さっき、上で彼女もそんなことを言ってまし
　た……」
dialogues.en:
"She said something like that, when I talked to her
earlier..."
dialogues.text:
"She said something like that, when I talked to her
earlier..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様は、いつにも増して熱心に育てられて
　いたようですが……」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress always seemed to be a different person when
trying to grow the plant..."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress always seemed to be a different person when
trying to grow the plant..."

dialogues.jp:
『残念でございます』と、瀬場さんは、心痛な
面持ちで、深いため息を吐いた。
dialogues.en:
"But it was unfortunate", he said, as he sighed with an
expression of heartache on his face.
dialogues.text:
"But it was unfortunate", he said, as he sighed with an
expression of heartache on his face.

dialogues.jp:
どんな願いをかけていたのか、本人の口から聞
かない限りわからないけれど、
dialogues.en:
I didn't know what wish it was, and would never hear it from
the person herself, but,
dialogues.text:
I didn't know what wish it was, and would never hear it from
the person herself, but,

dialogues.jp:
ロスキルラベンダーの種がないのなら、もう叶
えることはできない。
dialogues.en:
With no more Roskill Lavender seeds, there's no way the wish
will come true.
dialogues.text:
With no more Roskill Lavender seeds, there's no way the wish
will come true.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様をよろしくお願い致します。私はずっ
　と独りでいらっしゃるお嬢様が不憫でならな
　いのです……」
dialogues.en:
"Please, do something for the mistress... from the first day
I met her, I have felt utter compassion for her..."
dialogues.text:
"Please, do something for the mistress... from the first day
I met her, I have felt utter compassion for her..."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが、眉間を指で押さえ、声を震わせる。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san's fingers were resting on his forehead, and his
voice was cracking occasionally.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san's fingers were resting on his forehead, and his
voice was cracking occasionally.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「このまま、お嬢様はずっとこのお屋敷で独り
　ぼっちなのかと思いますと……この瀬場、思
　わず目頭が熱くなって来て参ります」
dialogues.en:
"The thought of the the mistress living alone in this
mansion for the rest of her life... it brings tears to my
very eyes."
dialogues.text:
"The thought of the the mistress living alone in this
mansion for the rest of her life... it brings tears to my
very eyes."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「──おお、かわいそうなお嬢様！　享司様、
　ソフィ様、お嬢様を、孤独の境地からお救い
　くださいませ！」
dialogues.en:
"--Ohh, my poor mistress! Kyouji-sama, Sophie-sama, please
save the mistress from her loneliness!"
dialogues.text:
"--Ohh, my poor mistress! Kyouji-sama, Sophie-sama, please
save the mistress from her loneliness!"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「や、その……瀬場さん。大丈夫ですよ、その」
dialogues.en: "h, hey, Seiba-san... it'd be alright..."
dialogues.text: "h, hey, Seiba-san... it'd be alright..."

dialogues.jp:
最後の辺りの台詞は、いくらなんでも大げさだ
ろ……。
dialogues.en:
Taking one final look around my surroundings, I took a deep
breath...
dialogues.text:
Taking one final look around my surroundings, I took a deep
breath...

dialogues.jp:
「俺だって、月城を寂しい目に遭わせたくない
　ですから」
dialogues.en:
"I don't ever want to see Tsukishiro's eyes so filled with
loneliness, again."
dialogues.text:
"I don't ever want to see Tsukishiro's eyes so filled with
loneliness, again."

dialogues.jp:
そう、俺は月城の笑顔が見たいのだ。彼女が心
から笑った笑顔が見たいのだ。
dialogues.en: I want to see her smile. A smile from deep within her heart.
dialogues.text: I want to see her smile. A smile from deep within her heart.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、きゅっと拳を強く握った。
dialogues.en: I squeezed my hand into a fist tightly; my resolve.
dialogues.text: I squeezed my hand into a fist tightly; my resolve.

dialogues.jp: ◆願いは叶わない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Ungrantable Wish◆
dialogues.text: ◆Ungrantable Wish◆

dialogues.jp: 月城の誕生日パーティーが開かれた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's birthday party began.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's birthday party began.

dialogues.jp:
月城もさすがに｛にぎ／賑｝やかな時間を楽しく過ごそう
としているのが見て取れる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro seemed to enjoy, somewhat, the bustle of her
birthday party, even if she didn't partake much in it.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro seemed to enjoy, somewhat, the bustle of her
birthday party, even if she didn't partake much in it.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、俺が、ロスキルラベンダーの代わりに
と思って買ってきた鉢植えは、逆効果だったよ
うで余計に月城にショックを与えてしまった。
dialogues.en:
However, my present, intended to replace the Roskill
Lavender, had the opposite effect instead, and gave her a
huge shock.
dialogues.text:
However, my present, intended to replace the Roskill
Lavender, had the opposite effect instead, and gave her a
huge shock.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、パーティーが終わった後は、休むから
と自室に戻っていった。
dialogues.en:
Eventually, Tsukishiro went to rest in her room, signalling
the end of the party.
dialogues.text:
Eventually, Tsukishiro went to rest in her room, signalling
the end of the party.

dialogues.jp:
悲しそうな月城。人形もいなくなり、ロスキル
ラベンダーもなくなり、自分は寂しい、自分は
独りぼっちだというのだった。
dialogues.en:
Poor Tsukishiro. No more doll, no more Roskill Lavender, so
lonely, yet will always be alone... according to her.
dialogues.text:
Poor Tsukishiro. No more doll, no more Roskill Lavender, so
lonely, yet will always be alone... according to her.

dialogues.jp:
いったいロスキルラベンダーとは、いったいな
んなのか。瀬場さんにそれを聞いて見ることに
した。
dialogues.en:
What on earth is this Roskill Lavender? I ended up asking
Seiba-san, who provided me with as much as he knew.
dialogues.text:
What on earth is this Roskill Lavender? I ended up asking
Seiba-san, who provided me with as much as he knew.

dialogues.jp:
ロスキルラベンダーとは、短い時間のみ咲く花
に願をかけるとどんな願いも叶うのだという。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, in the short time that the Roskill Lavender
blooms, any wish made upon it would be granted.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, in the short time that the Roskill Lavender
blooms, any wish made upon it would be granted.

dialogues.jp:
種がなくなった今、月城の願いが叶うことはも
うない。
dialogues.en:
But now, with no more seeds remaining, Tsukishiro's wish
won't ever be granted.
dialogues.text:
But now, with no more seeds remaining, Tsukishiro's wish
won't ever be granted.

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、俺に月城のことをお願いすると、
頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san then left everything up to me, bowing deeply.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san then left everything up to me, bowing deeply.

dialogues.jp: 俺だって、月城の笑顔が見たいのだ──。
dialogues.en: ***I want to see Tsukishiro smile too...
dialogues.text: ***I want to see Tsukishiro smile too...
